Borrowing from a whale is a legit strategy : )

Do mind that awakener level matters a lot in this game. If you can't use max-Mouchy to nuke the boss, you might want to boost your own units to provide support.

Survivability can be enhanced with caro realm ( free heal scaling with lost HP ), æquor ( free shield scaling with each turn you don't change the tentacle stance ), shielders ( Arachne, Winkle, Corposant, Lily, ... ), healers ( Salvador, Celeste, Clementine, Faint, Karen, ... ), debuffers ( Thaïs, Clementine, Karen, Corposant, ... )

Celeste and Faint are specific in the way Celeste gives a free death res ( once per encounter or every 6 turns if you enlighten her ) and Faint gives you extra death res on exhalt

There are two main differences between regular ultra and singularity ultra.
- Regular annihilation converts the leftmost card in ultra dpace into insight, gr1nting you draw and aliemus at the cost of delaying the ultra round.
> The alternate annihilation instead convert the card in ultra space into a copy in your hand, plus allows the new played card to trigger dimensionnal shuttle. So the ultra space is no longer depleted.

- the ultra round is a new round. Each status counts a round down, temporary buffs and debuffs vanish, retain effects trigger, prepare effects trigger.
> In singularity ultra, it's not a new turn. That means shield, extra arithmetica, unplayed cards and such all stay active.
That also means you can trigger annihilation, trigger Arachne's exhalt, fill the ultra space back again, trigger the turn extension and her ult is still in action.
